acknowledgement: Passive full original authority digest, exact mutation attempt and opaque retained reply evidence. Pure association authenticates no response/context and produces no outcome/receipt, Active custody or negative proof.
effects: Exactly one previously durably accounted application host update; no hidden reissues, batching, proxy/query substitution or funding.
Retain original obligations and restore source references before invocation. A routing target does not narrow whole-selection coverage.
Unavailable, Unsupported, Indeterminate, drop and death retain spent pending mutation, obligation and source references. No automatic nonapplication or refund.
Unknown dispatch or lost reply reconciles under an exact observation reservation; reconstructing a pending request never authorizes repeating mutation.
Separately qualified integrations may submit direct receipts through canonical journal owners only after actual original-request attribution. An acknowledgement alone is insufficient.
Terminal replay invokes no provider; no default implementation, actual acquisition qualification or terminal/fence/reference release exists.
kind: ephemeral exact application acquisition update port; no persisted authority schema

payload.arguments: 0..1048576 opaque original bytes; checked before copying, debug redacts content. Application codec owns whole-unit/purpose/fence/revision semantics.
payload.digest: NUL-terminated ASCII ic-backup/application-fence-acquisition/v1 domain; u8 raw principal length and raw identity; fixed update byte 1; big-endian u32 method byte length and exact ASCII bytes; big-endian u64 argument length and exact bytes.
payload.method: 1..128 visible ASCII bytes, case and punctuation retained exactly.
payload.nonrecursive: Payload is constructed before plan/requirement/obligation. These later owners bind exact payload digest; payload excludes their hashes and budgets. Application retains original bytes outside rewindable snapshots before effects.
payload.routing: Exact canonical application receiver equals original operation target and effective routing target; no management/proxy/query/default method.

request.admission: Structural binding is not a dispatch permit. Actual context, permissions, membership, original argument semantics, prerequisite evidence, exclusive custody and proof of no prior dispatch remain integration-owned.
request.original: Exact retained full plan, requirement-bound whole-unit obligation, payload target/digest and existing original acquisition journal authority including immutable budgets.
request.reservation: Requires exact already pending mutation and no pending observation; recheck current journal before reply association. Never create/reset/reserve spending.
